name: valleys_v1
note: Every world value of Four Valleys v1 (BRIDGE_DESIGN.md §2). All are design choices pending the owner's review. Its SHA-256 goes into the World Ledger.

collapse.note: H rises by 1 per down tick, so the body wakes at H = 8; E is unchanged. Death is off (owner switch).

loopBreak.note: per character, per life (Plan Rule 2); acts in every arm (critique finding 2a)

stage.note: S0a..S6 as 0..7; rises by one at a season end with no collapse in that valley; never falls; only the lens reads it

warnings.note: fear: visible before acting; HUNGRY and STARVING exclude each other. WEAK is H 1-4 (was 1-5) so that it is an exact predicate of the observation bands (critique finding 1).

values.note: V = gain - pain is the character's preference table (its wants) and the scorer's readout. It is not felt: felt pain is off (see feltPain). COLLAPSE replaces the tick's other terms.

observation.note: body and item fused into one OBS token (critique finding 1), so the slot that chooses the action sees the body; H 15 has its own band so ERR_FULL is decidable; H 1-2 and 3-4 make most collapses decidable at intensity 2

feltPain.rule: Owner ruling 2026-11-01: pain is a choice made at the higher-self level, never a designer setting; higher selves bring it down, not push it up. Felt pain is off: characters act on wants (the value table as preferences) and learn from answers. A character feels pain only once it has a higher self that chooses its catalysts (chose= on its soul line, stage 2); within a life intensity can only be lowered (world/valleys.mjs lowerIntensity; test W7).
